instruction: Turn off the screen dimming feature when the system is idle to keep the display at full brightness.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling idle screen dimming by setting org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power idle-dim to false. Evaluator verifies the setting value using gsettings get command.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: disabling screen dimming means setting idle-dim to false
Getter logic is correct: get_vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get' command to read the current idle-dim setting value

Expected value is correct: 'false\n' matches the gsettings command output format (value + newline)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (idle-dim setting value)
